ITEM 1 | Thinly sliced purple-red onion rings, pale lavender-white inner layers with magenta edges, glossy and moist, loosely piled in a stainless steel bowl, rings about 4-5 cm long and 0.3 cm thick, spread across roughly one-third of the bowl's interior | 45
ITEM 2 | Dark reddish-brown whole beans, smooth wrinkled skins with slight sheen, about 1.5-2 cm long and oval, scattered among the onion rings near the center-right of the bowl, appearing firm and intact | 40
ITEM 3 | Saucy mixture on a white plate at left edge: deep orange-red tomato-like sauce with chunky texture, glossy and moist, with thin golden-brown fried onion strands mixed through, partly spread and smeared across the plate, covering about one-fifth of the plate's visible area and about 1 cm high | 60
ITEM 4 | Small pale golden-brown crumb-like piece at the lower left edge of the plate, dry and irregular, about 1.5 cm across, next to the sauce | 5
